name: Accrual
tagline: AI-native platform that automates tax preparation and review for accounting firms.
description: Accrual is an AI-native accounting platform for firms that unifies tax preparation and review in one system. AI agents read client inputs, organize documents, flag missing data, and generate draft returns for professional sign-off, with source-document tracing and audit controls. Founded by engineers from Stripe and Brex, it currently focuses on individual tax returns.
insight: Launched February 2026 with $75M led by General Catalyst; founded by ex-Stripe and ex-Brex engineers.
edge: Purpose-built for tax-return prep and review — unifying both in one system rather than bolting AI onto a general-ledger product.
pros: AI drafts returns for professional sign-off
cons: Currently focused on individual tax returns

references.title: Accrual launches with $75M to bring AI-native automation to accounting
